kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: 经原厂资料核验的接口组件参考。

intro.en: Materials identified for the specific interface or molding process.
intro.zh: 用于具体接口或成型工艺选型的材料。

copy.en: Identify continuous temperatures, short peaks, dwell time, thermal cycling and current-generated heat at each zone.
copy.zh: 逐温区明确持续温度、短时峰值、停留时间、冷热循环及电流自发热。

copy.en: Review wire insulation, connector or sensor inserts, overmold resin and seals together. The lowest-rated element can limit the assembly.
copy.zh: 一并审核线材绝缘、连接器或传感器嵌件、包覆树脂与密封件；额定值最低的部件可能限制整套组件。

copy.en: Do not treat softening point, molding temperature or an unloaded resin temperature range as a finished cable operating rating.
copy.zh: 不能把软化点、成型温度或树脂无机械应力时的温区，当作成品电缆的工作额定值。

copy.en: Confirm jacket and housing compatibility, wall sections, mechanical interlocks, exit shape and stress relief through thermal expansion and contraction.
copy.zh: 确认护套与壳体相容性、壁厚、机械锁合、出线形状及热胀冷缩时的应力释放。

copy.en: Specify the actual oil, coolant, humidity or other exposure and the required sealing condition before and after thermal cycling.
copy.zh: 指定实际油液、冷却液、湿度或其他介质，以及冷热循环前后的密封要求。

copy.en: Freeze material identities, conditioning, tooling and the process window, then agree electrical, mechanical and environmental evidence for the real configuration.
copy.zh: 冻结材料身份、预处理、工装与工艺窗口，再为真实配置约定电气、机械与环境验证依据。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
